name: Replit Monitoring Agent
desc: On-call agent that investigates production alerts and ships a validated fix.
desc_zh: 排查线上告警并发布已验证修复的值班智能体。
solves: A small team has nobody to page at 2 a.m.; the agent reads the alert, finds the cause, tests a fix and publishes it.
solves_zh: 小团队凌晨两点没人可叫；智能体读告警、找原因、验证修复并直接发布。
best_for: Your app is live and the error report arrives while you are asleep.
best_for_zh: 应用已经上线，错误报告在你睡觉时到达。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — replit.com/blog）。 Post published Oct 22, 2026 (page byline: Published: Oct 22, 2026). An in-product surface of Replit, separate from Replit Agent and from Cloud Agents. 首次公开日期来源：https://replit.com/blog/replit-monitoring-agent
